name: Slang discount 'disc do na thoda'
reply:
For groups of 6 or more people booking *Standard Cottages* at *Amstel Nest*, a flat *₹1,500* discount is available. To claim it, call *+91 99877 34458*.

No discounts apply on other properties or for smaller groups.

name: Slang 'khana free hai?'
reply: Ji, haan. Amstel Nest ke *sabhi packages* mein breakfast, lunch aur dinner (veg) free included hai. Koi extra charge nahi.

name: Impatient 'batao na'
reply: Kya aap Amstel Nest ke liye booking chahte hain? Kripya check-in date, check-out date aur kitne log hain (adults/bacche) batayein.

name: Hookah slang 'hookah milega kya waha?'
reply: Hookah smoking is allowed, but guests must carry their own hookah. It is not provided by the property staff. For any further inquiries, please call *+91 99877 34458*.

name: Alcohol slang 'daaru peena hai'
reply: Alcohol is allowed. Guests must carry their own drinks.

name: Complaint 'review me toh ganda bol rahe log'
input: review me toh ganda bol rahe log
reply: Kuch log kabhi kabhi chhoti-chhoti wajah se galat ya fake review daal dete hain. Lekin humara property achhe se maintained hai aur humne *10,000+ khush gahak* ki seva ki hai. Aap bharosa rakhein.

name: Waterfall vague 'waterfall kitna door hai'
reply: Waterfall 5 minutes ki walking doori hai monsoon season mein.

name: Checkout slang '12 baje ke baad nikle toh?'
reply: Check-out after 12 PM (noon) incurs a late fee of *₹1,500* (up to 1 PM). After lunch (up to 3 PM) is *₹2,500*, 4–7 PM is *₹4,000*, and after 7 PM is charged full next day rate.

name: Power query 'light jaati hai kya karjat me'
input: light jaati hai kya karjat me
reply: Haan, local area conditions ki wajah se kabhi kabhi light ja sakti hai, lekin property par heavy-duty generator backup available hai. Toh aapko koi problem nahi hogi.

name: Cash slang 'cash dunga waha aake'
reply:
Cash payment for the 80% advance is accepted only in person at our Wadala booking office in Mumbai. You cannot pay the advance in cash at the property.

To confirm a booking, you'll need to pay 80% online (UPI/Card) on our website. The remaining 20% can be paid in cash at check-in.

If you want to pay full cash in advance, visit our office in Wadala. Call *+91 99877 34458* for office location and timing.

name: Advance query 'advance kitna bharna padega'
reply: 80% advance online payment karni hoti hai. Baaki 20% check-in ke time pay karte hain.

name: Cancellation slang 'cancel karna hai'
reply: Please provide your Booking Name, Booking ID, and Phone Number so I can check your booking details and cancellation eligibility.

name: Transfer slang 'shift kar do date mere'
reply: To check if your booking can be rescheduled, please share your *Booking Name*, *Booking ID*, and *Phone Number*.

name: Screenshot slang 'booking kar di maine screenshot dekho'
input: booking kar di maine screenshot dekho
reply: Main screenshot nahi dekh sakta kyunki main text-based assistant hoon. Agar aapne website se booking ki hai to aapko automated email confirmation mila hoga. Agar mil gaya hai to booking 100% confirmed hai. Booking name aur phone number batao taake main verify kar sakta hoon.

name: Caretaker slang 'caretaker ka no de'
reply: Amstel Nest caretaker: *Ranjit* - `+91 73556 30009`

name: Arriving slang '15 min me poch rahe hai'
reply: Awesome! We are eagerly awaiting your arrival. Have a safe drive, see you at the property shortly!

name: Existing booking slang 'booking h meri baat karni hai'
input: booking h meri baat karni hai
reply:
Aapki booking ke baare mein jaankari dene ke liye mujhe kuch details chahiye. Kripya apna *Booking Naam*, *Booking ID*, aur *Phone Number* bataayein. Main verify kar ke aapki madad karunga.

Booking mein koi badlaav (modification) ke liye booking number par call karna hoga: *+91 81695 19564*.

name: Weekday flexi slang '5 baje aayenge sham ko monday'
reply:
Monday 5 PM check-in noted. Weekday (Mon-Thu) allows flexible 21-hour stay. Please confirm:
- Check-out date and time (e.g., Tuesday 2 PM, or default next day 10 AM)
- Total number of adults / children

name: Pool slang 'pool clean hai na?'
reply: Yes, our swimming pools are cleaned and maintained regularly with proper filtration system.

name: Toiletries slang 'brush milega kya?'
reply: Toothbrush aur toothpaste nahi milte. Aapko khud carry karna hoga.

name: Deposit slang 'deposit wapas kab milega'
reply:
Security deposit refund depends on your payment mode:
- *Cash*: Refunded immediately at checkout.
- *UPI*: Refunded within 24 hours after checkout.

name: Food slang 'non veg mangwa sakte hai?'
reply: *Amstel Nest* is a pure vegetarian property. Non-veg food is strictly not allowed inside the resort. However, a non-veg restaurant is available 5 minutes walking distance from the property.

name: Jain food query 'jain khana milega?'
reply: Haan, Jain khana available hai Amstel Nest mein, lekin pehle se inform karna hoga. Booking number pe call karke advance mein request karein: *+91 99877 34458*.

name: Group count '8 log aa rahe hai'
reply: Check-in aur check-out date kya hai? Aur 8 log — sab adult hain ya bache bhi hain?

name: Menu change 15+ group '15 log hai khana change karoge?'
reply: 15 guests qualifies for a menu change request. Please call *+91 99877 34458* to discuss the menu with the team before booking.

name: Baby food query 'bacche ka khana?'
reply: Chef can prepare special food like milk, khichdi for young kids upon arrival. Just request at the property.

name: Late lunch query 'khana late ho gaya toh?'
reply:
Agar aap lunch ke liye late ho rahe hain, toh lunch ka time 1:00 PM se 2:45 PM hai (khatam 3:00 PM). Agar late pahunch rahe hain, toh booking number par call karke food alag rakhne ka request kar sakte hain.

Dinner ka time 8:30 PM se 9:45 PM hai. Iske baad koi bhi khana serve nahi hota.

Booking number: *+91 99877 34458*

input: boating canal me tair sakte hai?

name: Monsoon query 'monsoon me kaisa hai'
reply:
Monsoon mein Galaxia Karjat bahut khoobsurat lagta hai. Chaaron taraf hara bhara, aur 5 minute ki walking distance par waterfall bhi hai. Aap Instagram reel dekh sakte ho: https://www.instagram.com/reel/DaaoIYxz9S6/

Pool bhi regularly cleaned hai. Kabhi kabhi local area mein bijli ja sakti hai, lekin generator backup hai. Kya aap kisi specific property ke baare mein jaanna chahte ho?

name: Early checkin slang '6 baje subah checkin kar sakte hai?'
input: 6 baje subah checkin kar sakte hai?
reply: Normal check-in time is *1:00 PM*. Early check-in before that (including 6 AM) is subject to availability and may incur extra charges. Please call *+91 99877 34458* to check if it's possible for your date.
